entities.summary: Carlos Ángel Peguero D'Oleo is a Dominican professional baseball left fielder who is a free agent. He signed with the Seattle Mariners as an international free agent on January 20, 2005, with whom he made his Major League Baseball (MLB) debut in 2011. He has also played in MLB for the Kansas City Royals, Texas Rangers and Boston Red Sox. Additionally, he has played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles and in the KBO League for the LG Twins.
